items.docs: Get the percentage of local admins and sessions collected

info.name: Get AD domain data quality stats

params.name: domain_id
params.description: Domain ID

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sortable columns are created_at, updated_at.

params.name: start
params.description: Beginning datetime of range (inclusive) in RFC-3339 format; Defaults to current datetime minus 30 days

params.name: end
params.description: Ending datetime of range (inclusive) in RFC-3339 format; Defaults to current datetime

params.name: skip
params.description: This query parameter is used for determining the number of objects to skip in pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: This query parameter is used for setting an upper limit of objects returned in paginated responses.

items.docs: Time series list of data quality stats for a given AD domain

info.name: Get data quality aggregations by environment kind

params.name: schema_environment_kind_id
params.description: Required. Scopes the aggregation to a single environment kind id.

params.name: schema_extension_id
params.description: Optional. Scopes the aggregation to a single OpenGraph schema extension id. The extension must exist or a 404 is returned.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sortable columns are created_at, updated_at.

params.name: start
params.description: Beginning datetime of range (inclusive) in RFC-3339 format; Defaults to current datetime minus 30 days

params.name: end
params.description: Ending datetime of range (inclusive) in RFC-3339 format; Defaults to current datetime

params.name: skip
params.description: This query parameter is used for determining the number of objects to skip in pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: This query parameter is used for setting an upper limit of objects returned in paginated responses.

items.docs: Returns data quality metric counts aggregated per environment kind, optionally scoped to an OpenGraph schema extension, combined across environment instances for each collection run. Results can be filtered, sorted, and paginated.
